summary: Short, steep dead-end kerb with a house 10 m away and restrictions.
reasons: No Stopping sign and resident permits

drivers.seclusion: Houses 10-17 m away on both sides; end of a narrow lane among homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane, vehicles parked in the lane; a van would block it. 12 m is under a van length of room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane, but residents drive in and out.
drivers.convention: Resident-permit parking with a No Stopping sign nearby; no overnight convention.

flags: Steep: 14.3% mean, 16.2% max, above the 12% limit
Signs: No Stopping Any Time and 2P resident permits excepted, Mon-Fri 7am-7pm
sun_shade: Open from the east; trees overhang the south end.
rubbish: some litter at the lane edge
cannot_judge: Whether the lane end is a turning area
